atAGlance: Gỏi gà xé phay is shredded chicken salad, usually with cabbage, rau răm, onion, peanuts, and tart fish-sauce dressing.
whatItIs: Gỏi gà xé phay is shredded chicken salad with cabbage or banana blossom, rau răm, onion, peanuts, fried shallots, and fish-sauce-lime dressing.
howToEnjoy: Toss lightly and eat with herbs in every bite. Peanuts and fried shallots add crunch; ask for them out if allergies matter.
howLocalsOrder: Order gỏi gà xé phay as a shared chicken salad. Ask for no peanuts, less onion, or less chili before it is dressed.
worthKnowing: In Vietnamese chicken salad, xé phay tells you the chicken is shredded by hand, which helps the herbs and dressing cling to it.
goodToKnow: Ask for không cay if you want Gỏi gà xé phay without added chili.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gỏi gà xé phay.
